niche.active: Nocturnal (haze thins, cooler, trace O2 pools form)

body: Camouflaged silica-moss skin, venomous barbs, wide-angled binocular eyes, low-profile body

links: Amber daylight makes bright colors conspicuous
observe: Moss spores drift away when it moves

plausibility.summary: Amber, red-weighted daylight (F8) makes high-chroma prey conspicuous on shallow silica-rich substrates (F13). Cryptic iron-silica pigmentation plus epibiotic 'moss' matches ambush on epeiric shelves (F10). Stealth failing in murky water is coherent because vision-based camouflage needs sufficient transmitted light structure.
